In detail

Bellas Vistas has drawn repeated resident complaints about street robberies and noise around specific streets, leading the district council to approve extra patrols and cameras in October 2024. Police figures cited in the same coverage show violent robbery is a small share of district crime, and insecurity ranked well below cleanliness/noise in a 2019 resident survey -- a localized, moderate concern rather than a broadly dangerous neighbourhood. Sources checked: El Espanol, Dec 2024; elDiario.es 'Somos Tetuan'; El Salto Diario; Vice.es.
